preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= a[i] <= n for i in range(n)) and a[0] == 1 and len(set(a)) == n
preconditions.description: The sequence a must have n unique integers from 1 to n, with the first element being 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum possible height of the tree for each test case.
